title: Integrate shared verifier with runner
objective: Refactor runner task-completion verification to the shared verification engine while preserving fresh execution of every declared command occurrence and dependency closure, existing allowlist/sandbox enforcement and whole-worktree mutation postconditions.
test_seam: Runner regression tests must first show that cached integration evidence, duplicate mapped commands, unmapped legacy commands and selective fingerprints cannot replace fresh outer task-completion execution or whole-worktree mutation detection.
